entities.name: Abdul-Wahid Aziz
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Abdul-Wahid Aziz was an Iraqi weightlifter. He won a bronze medal in the lightweight division at the 1960 Summer Olympics, and, as of the 2024 Paris Olympics, remains the only person to win an Olympic medal for Iraq.
